title: Mean bound for a Boolean sign function
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Its uniform mean satisfies $|2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{-1,1\}^n}f(x)|\leq 1$.
